paper_record.title: Temporal wave trapping from dynamical pump pulses
paper_record.abstract: Temporal reflection in nonlinear optical fibers provides a powerful framework for manipulatinglight. In this work, we theoretically and experimentally demonstrate a novel mechanism for wavetrapping induced by the dynamical evolution of a single high-order soliton pulse. Experimentalmeasurements performed in a 5-km-long nonlinear dispersion shifted fiber confirm the coexistence ofreflected, transmitted, and trapped components, in excellent agreement with theoretical predictions.These results establish a simple and versatile route toward dynamic temporal waveguiding using asingle optical pulse, opening new opportunities for all-optical control and manipulation of ultrafastsignals.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 研究证明了单束高阶孤子脉冲的动力学演化可以在非线性光纤中诱导波捕获和时间反射。
one_sentence_summary.en: The study demonstrates that the dynamical evolution of a single high-order soliton pulse can induce wave trapping and temporal reflection in nonlinear fibers.

problem.zh: 传统的时间反射和波捕获通常需要多孤子配置或极短（小于1皮秒）的泵浦脉冲，限制了其应用灵活性。
problem.en: Conventional temporal reflection and wave trapping typically require multi-soliton configurations or ultrashort (<1 ps) pump pulses, limiting application flexibility.

approach.zh: 利用广义非线性薛定谔方程进行理论模拟，并在5公里长的色散位移光纤中通过皮秒泵浦脉冲与连续探测波的相互作用进行实验验证。
approach.en: Theoretical modeling using the generalized NLSE and experimental validation in a 5-km dispersion-shifted fiber by interacting a picosecond pump pulse with a CW probe wave.

main_takeaway.zh: 单束高阶孤子在传播过程中的自压缩和双脉冲形成阶段，足以产生足够强的瞬时强度梯度来捕获并反射探测波。
main_takeaway.en: The self-compression and bipulse formation stages of a single high-order soliton provide a sufficient instantaneous intensity gradient to trap and reflect probe waves.

why_it_matters.zh: 该发现简化了全光信号处理的实现方式，为超快信号的动态控制和时间波导提供了一种更简单、通用的途径。
why_it_matters.en: This finding simplifies the implementation of all-optical signal processing, providing a simpler and more versatile route for dynamic control and temporal waveguiding of ultrafast signals.

reason.zh: 该研究突破了以往对多脉冲或超短脉冲的依赖，首次展示了单脉冲内在动力学实现波捕获的可能性。
reason.en: The study breaks the previous dependence on multi-pulse or ultrashort pulse setups, demonstrating for the first time wave trapping via single-pulse intrinsic dynamics.

reason.zh: 论文结合了深入的非线性光学理论与光纤实验验证，非常符合该期刊的偏好。
reason.en: The paper combines in-depth nonlinear optics theory with fiber experimental validation, fitting the journal's scope well.
